result.brief: 提出基于视觉 Mamba 的紧凑 JEPA 框架，用扫描路径视图与对抗视图耦合实现跨传感器遥感图像检索的自监督表征学习。
result.reason: Proposes a JEPA-style joint-embedding predictive self-supervised framework with novel scan-path views and adversarial view coupling for cross-sensor representation learning, directly a visual representation contribution.
